description: This file defines a React component 'SettingsSidebar' for rendering and managing a sidebar with tabs in a settings interface, including handling keyboard navigation and tab selection.

classes.name: SettingsSidebar
classes.description: A React component for rendering a settings sidebar with tabs, supporting click and keyboard navigation.

methods.name: getVisibleTabs
methods.description: Returns all tabs (including plugin tabs) that are set to be displayed.

methods.name: handleClick
methods.description: Handles click events on tabs, updating the active tab and displaying content.

methods.name: handleKeyDown
methods.description: Handles keyboard navigation (up/down arrows) between tabs.

methods.name: renderTab
methods.description: Renders an individual tab button with icon and label.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the entire sidebar with tabs and plugin tabs.
